topic: Original retail renderer camera projection, work arenas, and type-10 highlight GEO dispatch
summary: Original retail instructions (Ghidra x86 emulation) initialize global camera projection 004C2730 with two math services substituted, initialize the renderer spatial bucket arenas 0048F9B0 with allocator services substituted, and consume original native-vehicle type-10 highlight records at 00490640. Two vehicle first-face tests reach the cull path and no polygon submission under synthetic camera; separate from type-6 geometry renderer. Two byte-identical repetitions per probe; 52 independently checked assertions.
